nom: The INKEY List SuperSolutions Blemish Clearing Moisturizer 2% Novoretin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report positive results, including one who tamed hormonal acne within a week and another who found it hydrating without leaving skin greasy; some other reviewers recommend it especially for oily skin types.
segments.dry: The reviewer who describes dry, scarred, acne-prone skin found the burning severe enough to wash the product off within minutes, while another notes it left her skin a little dry, which she considered normal for a retinol-containing product.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report reduced blemishes, smoother texture, and a more even skin tone after a few weeks, with initial tingling that settles down.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as having sensitive skin mostly report the product is gentle once tolerance builds, describing brief stinging or tingling but no lasting irritation and good results on blemishes; notably, a couple of reviewers who say they do not have sensitive or acne-prone skin still reported a severe reaction with burning, redness, and pustules.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who state their age, 40 and late 30s, both report the product cleared hormonal acne effectively despite initial stinging.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the moisturizer keeps skin hydrated despite containing retinol and sulfur, with several specifically surprised it didn't dry them out; a few others, however, say it left their skin somewhat dry, which some consider typical for a retinol-based product.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report reduced redness around blemishes and overall calmer-looking skin with continued use; however, several reviewers, especially among first-time or short-term users, report the product itself caused new redness, ranging from mild to severe and sometimes lasting a couple of days.
concerns.barrier: Almost all reviewers report some stinging or tingling on application, which most describe as brief and something they built tolerance to with gradual use. For a notable minority, however, the reaction was severe: burning, intense redness, or pustules that required stopping use immediately, and one reviewer describes lasting damage to her skin barrier.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report visibly fewer and smaller blemishes, less redness and swelling, and some improvement in acne scarring or dark marks within one to a few weeks, including several with hormonal or persistent acne. A minority, however, report no improvement even after months of use, and one reviewer says it triggered new breakouts in an area she had never had breakouts before, leaving dark marks behind.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the product controls oiliness well and doesn't leave a greasy residue, and one notes the sulfur helps minimize the look of enlarged, oil-related pores; one reviewer, however, felt it left an oily residue on the skin.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report visible fading of dark spots and post-acne pigmentation within a few weeks of use; one reviewer, however, says the new breakouts it caused for her left dark marks that would not fade.

aspects.libelle: Pills and rubs off under other products
Absorbs quickly without a greasy residue
Sticky feeling on the pillow at night

extraits.texte: I am so dissapointed. I bought this thinking it would clear my persistent breakouts, I read the reviews and thought it would work. The first time I used it my face stung a lot, turned very red and my eyes started to water, although I didn't see any improvement in my skin after a few weeks I kept at it. I then went on to buy a second bottle of this mousturiser thinking that maybe if I keep using it then I will notice some improvement. It was quite opposite. Instead I have breakouts all over my cheeks (I have never broke out there before i only used to get breakouts on my forehead) that just will not go away! The breakouts on my cheeks have really made me quite upset as that has never happened to me before. When a spot on my cheek eventually goes it leaves a really dark mark that will not go and stays ever since my spot was there. Overall I would not recommend this product as it has made my skin worse not better, I also believe that this product has damaged my skin barrier.

extraits.titre: Made me breakout when I had great skin
extraits.texte: It cost me a lot of research and self-convincing to try out this product. As others have noted the smell is so strong that it affected me for days. I used this product once and woke up with severe pustules on my face. It was burning, red and felt like sandpaper. I have never in my life experienced something like this although I have tried many products. I went back to boots and they said they cannot refund me if I developed an allergic reaction? I do not have sensitive or acne prone skin. This has been a shocking experience and now I am forced to spend more money on products the remedy this. I feel uncomfortable leaving my house because my face is completely ruined.

I have dry acne that leaves a lot of scars and thought this product would be perfect as it's a moisturiser as well as a blemish clearer but the burning sensation on my skin was so bad that I had to scrub it off within 5 mins and my face is now very red and inflamed. The smell is also unbearable

Stingy when first applied with a sulfur smell (which I expected going in, so not surprised), and the product texture was less smooth than I expected. Not noticing huge results yet after 2 months, but my skin isn't reacting negatively either as I only apply to my oily T Zone (not any drier areas) aiming to combat blocked pores and blackheads.

I received this product complimentary from The INKEY List in exchange for my review. This product has been a great welcome to my routine especially as of late, as my skin has been slightly stressed and breaking out in certain areas. I used The INKEY List Blemish Clearing 2% Novoretin moisturiser according to the instructions on the packaging, which I found to be easy to follow. To note, I used it in the evening only and for around 4 weeks before gathering my thoughts and publishing this review. I have sensitive skin and was surprised at how this product didn't dry my skin at all - rather, it helped renew my texture and my skin feels brighter and more smooth after using it for the this time period. I found it easy to apply, thanks to its lightweight texture and it also fit into my current routine well too, without disturbing it much. Since it has Retinol, I did make sure I used an SPF daily. I have to say, I love the focus on ingredients in this product. I highly recommend this fantastic moisturiser for any blemishes and distressed skin you may have. I will use it as my go-to for when the skin is troubled, to help it recover cohesively, but maintain that moisture.

I have combination skin and have suffered with blemishes for a while and this is my new favourite evening moisturiser now. Make sure to patch test if you've never used retinols before and also make sure to wear spf the next day . I've started using this moisturiser almost 2 months ago and I'm very happy with the results so far . The texture is nice and creamy and absorbs well leaving slightly sticky feeling which is ok to me for overnight moisturiser. There might be slight tingling sensation at first aplication. At first use twice a week and slowly increase to every evening. This moisturiser is to be used as part of my evening skincare routine after I've cleansed my face I add pea sized amount of the product to my skin. My skin feels much smoother and blemishes have significantly reduced so far. My skintone is visibly more even and skin texture improved. If you have blemishes then you should definitely give this moisturiser a go . I received this product Complimentary from The Inkey list in exchange for my honest review.
